title: Effective thin slice view of life

title: Fantastic habit tracker
body: I’ve used this app for years and it’s been a super reliable method to track my habits and review changes over time. Does what it says on the box. Can highly recommend.

title: Motlatjo

title: Cornerstone of my habits
body:
Way of Life forces your be aware. It's easy to say that you "meditate every day" or "consistently journal" but Way of Life keeps you accountable and puts the data in your palm. 

Great app and I love the new features!

title: Great app!
body: This really helps me. I love being able to fill in my day's activities. The fact that you can customize it means that the possibilities are endless.
author: steegs00

title: Fantastic
body: This app is fantastic. I was skeptical at first, thinking that an app can't help me improve my habits, but I have found that in only 2 weeks my habits have improved. This works very well and I recommend it to anyone trying to improve their own habits.

title: Excellent App
body:

Simple to use and effective.
